'''Folded Light''' is a [[weave]] that uses threads of [[Fire (disambiguation)|Fire]] and [[Air (disambiguation)|Air]].

This weave folds light around an object, such as a person, so that any attempt to view the object slides past it and behind it. This effectively renders the subject invisible.

While typically stationary, it has been claimed that Rand uses this ability to mask his presence while he walks.{{ref/book|8|29}}
